metrics.caveat_notice: SINGLE CASE STUDY NOTICE: This replay represents a single historical heat event (N=1). Reported timeliness and precision reflect strict as-of-date evaluation under empirical reporting delays. General multi-outbreak performance must be referenced to the multi-injection validation benchmark.

limitations: Single Case Study: Evaluated on one historical heat dome event (N=1). Generalization requires multi-injection validation.
Reporting Delay Simulation: CDC NSSP facility reporting latency is simulated using an empirical 3-day geometric distribution (70% D+1, 20% D+2, 10% D+3).
Regional Aggregation: Outcome counts represent HHS Region 10 aggregate visits; fine-grained municipal hospital breakdown is not publicly released.
Weather Forecast Horizon: 48-hour forward forecasts utilize archived NWP model predictions without post-hoc assimilation adjustments.
